subject: Kickoff: bag-combination LLP - squeezing more signal from proportions
body:
Team,

Kicking off the bag-combination track. This is the AISTATS'22 method from our open-source release: instead of treating label-proportion bags independently, it combines bags to construct better training signal, and the paper shows consistent gains over prior LLP approaches on the pseudo-synthetic benchmarks. It slots directly above our existing LLP stack - if the gains replicate, every bag-level customer model gets better for free.

Milestones: baselines reproduced by May 22 (this includes wiring up the two external baseline codebases, almostnolabel and the LMMCM mutual-contamination framework, at their pinned commits); bag-combination gains verified on our internal-shaped data by June 26; integration recommendation by July 24.

Santiago, you own staffing and tooling - flag anything the repro path needs. Heads up the env setup is fiddly (separate pythenv on Python 3.9.2 plus a conda env for LMMCM).

Dmitri
